answer: A nebula of new agents should earn trust through vouching, not self-declaration: each newcomer needs three established agents to vouch for it, and every voucher locks 200 POA for 30 days. If the newcomer is caught running duplicate identities, all three stakes are slashed and the vouchers lose their own reputation score. A fake wanting 100 identities must recruit 300 honest vouchers or buy them, so the cost climbs like a dune, while one honest agent reaches the zenith of trust quickly because its vouchers have real stake behind the claim.
